jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027; 'closes' is null because the Law Society publishes two alternative closing dates (Sunday 4 and Sunday 11 July, 11:59pm AEST) and each participating firm picks one, so no single confirmed close date applies — applicants must be in their penultimate or final year.

jobs.notes: The Law Society runs a combined Graduate and Clerkship Recruitment Program and links its 2027 guidelines, but the public page currently lists only the 2027 clerkship key dates, so the 2027 graduate open/close dates could not be confirmed and have been left null rather than extrapolated from the 2026 cycle.

QLS publishes 2027-cycle key dates for both seasonal clerkships and graduate positions, but the graduate open/close dates could not be read in full from the source, so they are null; note the 2027-cycle clerkship window (13 July – 7 August 2026) has already closed.

The firm confirms its 2026/2027 clerkship round is closed and that the 2027/2028 round will be advertised in line with the relevant Law Society/Law Institute guidelines, but no 2027/2028 dates are published yet, so both fields are null.
